terms_content:
Welcome to Patria Lounge. By using our mobile application and services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.

1.1 Service Description
Patria Lounge provides an online platform for ordering from our full restaurant menu, including premium meals, beverages, specialty coffee, and desserts, for delivery, pickup, or dine-in pre-ordering in Alexandria, Egypt. Our service aims to provide a high-end, comprehensive culinary experience.

1.2 Account Registration
To place an order, you may be required to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account details and for all activities that occur under your account.

1.3 Ordering and Pricing
Accuracy: By placing an order, you agree that all details provided are accurate and complete.
Availability: All menu items are subject to availability. As our dishes and ingredients are prepared fresh, certain items may sell out. We reserve the right to offer substitutes or cancel orders if items are unavailable.
Pricing: All prices are listed in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.

1.4 Delivery and Pickup
Delivery Area: We operate within specific zones in Alexandria. If an address is outside our coverage, we reserve the right to cancel the order.
Timing: Delivery times are estimates. Factors such as traffic in Alexandria or high order volume at the lounge may affect timing.
Responsibility: The customer must be available to receive the order at the specified time and location.

1.5 Allergens and Health
Our dishes and drinks may contain nuts, gluten, dairy, and other allergens. While we take maximum precautions in our kitchen, Patria Lounge cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment. Please specify any allergies or dietary restrictions in the order notes or contact our team directly.

1.6 Cancellation and Refunds
Due to the perishable and made-to-order nature of our food and gourmet dishes, orders cannot be cancelled once preparation has begun. Refunds are only issued in cases of incorrect items or quality issues verified by our management.
privacy_content:
At Patria Lounge, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring your personal information is handled safely.

1.1 Information We Collect
Personal Details: Name, phone number, and email address for account management and reservations.
Location Data: Delivery address and GPS location to facilitate accurate delivery services.
Payment Information: We do not store full credit card details. Payments are processed through secure third-party gateways.
Usage Data: Information on how you interact with the app to improve our menu options and user experience.

1.2 How We Use Your Information
We use your data to:
Process, prepare, and deliver your food orders.
Send order status updates or reservation confirmations via SMS or WhatsApp or Notifications.
Provide premium customer support.
Send promotional offers related to Patria Lounge (you may opt-out at any time).

1.3 Data Sharing
We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with:
Delivery Personnel: Only the necessary contact and address details to fulfill your delivery order.
Legal Authorities: If required by Egyptian law or to protect our legal rights.

1.4 Data Security
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

1.5 Your Rights
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information stored in the Patria Lounge app. You can manage these settings directly in the app or by contacting our support team.
